column3: “the manner of women” refers to menstruation.
“the fear of Isaac” renders “pahad Yitshaq,” a divine title of uncertain sense (also in verse 53).
“Jegar-sahadutha” is Aramaic and “Galeed” is Hebrew, both meaning “heap of witness.”
“judge” has a plural verb in the Hebrew, and “the God of their father” is missing in the Greek.
